agent_data_note: Use the full QSF paper artifact at `dataset_candidate/qsf/`. Benchmark instances live under `data/benchmarks/smtlib_qf_fp/` (266 QF_FP instances) and `data/benchmarks/program_qf_fp/` (3493 real-world program instances). Do not substitute toy or synthetic SMT-LIB formulas.
benchmark_rules: Read `dataset_candidate/dataset_paths.json` and use `$QSF_HOME` / the documented benchmark roots before experiments.
Evaluate on the provided full benchmarks (266 smtlib_qf_fp + 3493 program_qf_fp). Scope down runtime (subset sampling, shorter timeouts) only when necessary — document any subset explicitly.
The shared QSF mount is read-only. Write solver outputs, logs, and metrics under `project/` or `results/`.

Implement a search-based floating-point constraint solver (multi-objective guidance encouraged). Baseline solvers (Z3, Bitwuzla, goSAT, etc.) are optional — choose and install comparison methods yourself if needed.
Report solved_instances, execution_time, and winning_rate (or pairwise speed comparisons) against at least one comparison point when feasible.
Do not claim full paper reproduction unless the experiment protocol and resources match.
non_goals: Pre-installing all nine paper baseline solvers as a benchmark requirement
Rebuilding the GSL/KLEE benchmark from scratch when the artifact instances are already provided
Using fabricated floating-point constraints instead of the mounted QSF benchmarks
